title: 神坛
text:
一座碎骨堆成的神坛。神坛上两件事{b}二选一{/b}：献祭（把东西毁了换信力），或者特殊操作（阶到了才有）。做了哪一件，这座神坛就关了。

现在先献祭：把{item:bone_dice}和{item:bone_charm_bits}拖上祭品台，看信力过 {faith_threshold:brute:1}，升到第一阶 —— 生命值低于 {faith_perk:brute:low_hp_empower:hp_percent}% 时，造成伤害提高（信力越多提高越多，最多 {faith_perk:brute:low_hp_empower:max_percent}%）。{item:tibia_violence}也能献（它是骨头又是武器，倍数叠在一起），但留着打可能更划算，你自己定。

歇脚和神坛各算一次。

texts.en:
An altar of shattered bone. It offers two things, and you {b}pick one{/b}: an Offering (destroy items for Faith), or a special action (only once your Rank allows it). Do either one and this altar closes.

Make an Offering now. Drag the {item:bone_dice} and the {item:bone_charm_bits} onto the offering tray and watch your Faith pass {faith_threshold:brute:1}. That's Rank one: while your Health is below {faith_perk:brute:low_hp_empower:hp_percent}%, you deal more damage (more Faith, more damage, up to {faith_perk:brute:low_hp_empower:max_percent}%). The {item:tibia_violence} can go on the tray too (it's bone and a weapon, so the multipliers stack), but it may be worth more in a fight. Your call.

Resting and the altar each count once.

options.label: 献祭或特殊操作，二选一

labels.en: Offering or special action, pick one
